_comment: Per-portal ingest metadata. Copy to portal_ingest_config.json (gitignored) and fill with real values from your HAPI patient sub-identities. Backed up nightly via restic (scripts/backup.sh).
_note_patient_refs: The FHIR Patient reference is created once when you first connect a portal via patient consolidation (see tools/patient_consolidation/). Query HAPI: /Patient?_tag=urn:bina:src-portal|<portal>.<vendor>
